ARG BUILDKIT_SBOM_SCAN_CONTEXT=true
ARG BUILDKIT_SBOM_SCAN_STAGE=true
ARG PRESQUASH_SCRIPTS="rm -rf /tmp/* /usr/share/doc/* /var/lib/apt/lists/*; find /var/cache /var/log -type f -delete"
FROM scratch AS temp-<id>
COPY --link --from=<image> / /
FROM temp-<id> AS temp-<id>-cleaned
ENV PATH="/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin"
ENV TEST_BACKSLASH="C:\\dir\\file"
ENV TEST_SPECIAL="say \"hi\" for \$5, a=b"
ARG PRESQUASH_SCRIPTS
RUN sh -c "$PRESQUASH_SCRIPTS" || true
FROM temp-<id>${PRESQUASH_SCRIPTS:+-cleaned} AS temp-<id>-final
FROM scratch AS squashed-<id>
COPY --link --from=temp-<id>-final / /
LABEL "test.backslash"="C:\\dir\\file \\n"
LABEL "test.dollar"="costs \$HOME"
LABEL "test.key with space"="it's ok"
LABEL "test.multiline"="line 1\n\nline 3\n"
LABEL "test.quote"="say \"hi\""
SHELL ["/bin/bash","-o","pipefail","-c"]
ENV PATH="/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin"
ENV TEST_BACKSLASH="C:\\dir\\file"
ENV TEST_SPECIAL="say \"hi\" for \$5, a=b"
ONBUILD RUN echo "on build" && exit 1
ONBUILD COPY src /dst
EXPOSE 80/tcp
EXPOSE 8080/udp
WORKDIR /app
USER 1000:1000
VOLUME ["/data dir"]
VOLUME ["/var/log"]
ENTRYPOINT ["/entry point","--flag=\"x\""]
CMD ["arg 1","$HOME","back\\slash"]
STOPSIGNAL SIGQUIT
HEALTHCHECK --interval=300s --timeout=3s --start-period=10s --start-interval=2s --retries=5 CMD curl --fail http://localhost/ || exit 1
